source_instruction: find me a jar of baby food that is certified organic. it should also be non gmo.
query: The community garden plot I signed up for last month is finally producing the wildest mix of stuff right now—my cherry tomato plants are so heavy with fruit they’ve flopped over twice despite the stakes I hammered in, the volunteer sunflowers that popped up along the fence are taller than I am, and the bunch of basil I stuck in the corner is so fragrant I can smell it before I even unlock the garden gate. I stopped by earlier today to pull a few weeds and ended up chatting with the retired lady who has the plot next to mine for almost 45 minutes; she gave me a jar of her homemade dill pickles and told me her secret for keeping slugs off the leafy greens is to leave little dishes of cheap beer around the base of the plants, which I would’ve never thought to try on my own. I even spotted a tiny fluffy baby rabbit darting under the raspberry bushes on my way out, so still for a second I thought it was a stuffed animal someone left propped there until it twitched its nose and hopped further into the brush. Right now I’m browsing the meat substitutes section. All the options that align for me are non-GMO, and I’m sticking to a reasonable budget for this trip. I’ve heard that options that fit those two parameters work really well for folks browsing this section.
